A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Hyperbolic Dataset Distillation study. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison, including material relocated or renumbered in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original distillation experiments, hierarchical-pruning results, cross-architecture evaluations, and synthetic-image visualizations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds runtime and memory measurements, curvature-sensitivity results, and experiments applying HDD to DSDM.

M1.justification: Section 4.3 changes the stated pruning rule from ranking the original dataset by per-sample curvature to ranking a batch by the Lorentz time component. This revises the reported selection procedure; the central hyperbolic centroid-matching method remains unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six image-classification datasets: FashionMNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet, and ImageWoof. The additional DSDM, curvature, and efficiency experiments use existing CIFAR-10 coverage.

E2.justification: Appendix J adds a direct comparison between DSDM and DSDM with HDD. DSDM already appeared in v1 Table 3, but only as a comparator in the Dance-based comparison. Comparator memberships in the retained tables remain unchanged.

E3.justification: v2 adds a 1,000-iteration timing protocol reported per 100 iterations, a curvature sweep, and DSDM-based evaluation settings. Appendix G also changes curvature headers from K to -1/K while retaining the entries, revising the reported parameter interpretation. These changes do not establish that earlier experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Sections 4.5–4.6 and Appendix J substantially expand supplementary validation with computational-overhead measurements, curvature sensitivity, and a controlled DSDM-with/without-HDD study. The earlier pruning, cross-architecture, and geometric-visualization analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both experimental sections specify three runs and mean plus standard deviation. v2 newly states in checklist item 7 that reported uncertainties are standard errors of the mean, creating conflicting uncertainty descriptions. No increase in runs or new statistical testing is documented.

E6.justification: The retained result tables are numerically unchanged, but new Tables 4, 5, and 10 substantially extend the results with resource costs, curvature responses, and DSDM integration. For example, Table 10 reports 43.8±0.2% for DSDM versus 46.4±0.3% with HDD at IPC=1. These are newly reported comparisons, not improvements over v1 scores.

T1.justification: Equations 6–7 add sqrt(-K) factors to the exponential maps, and Equation 16 removes the sinh denominators from the tangent-vector definitions. These are targeted mathematical revisions; the corresponding general formulas and theoretical arguments in Appendices A–D were already present.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same scientific claims about hyperbolic centroid matching, hierarchical sample influence, compatibility, improved distillation, and retaining performance with 20% of the original data.

C2.justification: v2 newly interprets HDD's measured overhead as modest and largely independent of IPC, with negligible memory cost, and describes accuracy as relatively insensitive to curvature. Existing interpretations of prototype bias, excessive pruning, and future hyperbolic distribution metrics remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 replaces the promised future code release with a repository link and an availability statement. It also documents RTX 4090 hardware and timing procedures for the new efficiency experiment and revises the curvature parameter labels in Appendix G.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds citations to task-specific generative distillation with difficulty-guided sampling and information-guided diffusion sampling. The research positioning remains unchanged. Consolidating duplicate references and preprint/publication entries does not remove distinct prior work.

P1.justification: Most scientific prose and the narrative order are retained. v2 adds localized experimental subsections, a DSDM appendix, acknowledgments, and the NeurIPS checklist, alongside light copyediting and revised author, contact, and conference text.

P2.justification: v2 adds three tables, enlarges and relocates Table 3, and corrects Figure 4's reversed original/synthetic color legend without changing its plotted points. The author block and appendix figures are rearranged; the earlier diagrams and synthetic-image panels are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 provides useful efficiency, curvature-sensitivity, and DSDM validation absent from v1. The revised pruning description, mathematical expressions, figure legend, and code-access information also improve clarity and reproducibility. These targeted gains outweigh the newly introduced standard-deviation-versus-standard-error inconsistency, while the principal benchmark results and theoretical arguments remain largely unchanged.
